title: OpenRTB 3.0 AdCOM video placement answered with a VAST 4.1 media.ad.video creative

source.name: IAB AdCOM 1.0 FINAL — Object: VideoPlacement / Object: Video, composed with the OpenRTB 3.0 FINAL transaction envelope
source.version: AdCOM 1.0 FINAL, accessed 2026-09-07; OpenRTB 3.0 FINAL commit 9af34fc79580f67f6abaf89b1e48d18398c9a697
source.license: CC BY 3.0 (AdCOM/OpenRTB 3.0 object definitions); MIT (original fixture)
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All auction, bid, creative, site and publisher identifiers are synthetic.
All domains use reserved .test names; device.ip is the documentation-only address 192.0.2.12.

AdCOM VideoPlacement.mime/ctype/mindur/maxdur and the response Ad.video.mime/ctype/dur/adm field names are used exactly as defined by AdCOM 1.0 (video's own mime/ctype are distinct from the sibling Display object's singular-string mime).

reference.sourceIds cites banner-native:bn-ortb30 for the OpenRTB 3.0 transaction envelope (Item/Bid, request/response wrapper) — that record documents the envelope generically, not banner-specific content; the video-specific AdCOM Ad.video/VideoPlacement objects are cited separately via video-audio:va-adcom.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: Every response bid references an offered item; auction identifiers match.

specNotes: AdCOM's response Ad.video has no w/h attribute (dimensions live inside the VAST adm); packages/core/crosscheck.js's projectBid30 reads w/h only from display, so no size crosscheck fires for a video-only 3.0 bid either way.

media.ad.video.adm is preferred over the (absent) media.ad.display.adm, matching resolveAdCom's display-first fallback order; the crosscheck video_vast finding's path is openrtb.response.seatbid[0].bid[0].media.ad.video.adm.
Validity describes protocol structure and declared constraints; generated media bytes must be checked against declared MIME/duration before playback tests.
Current Inspector contract displays VAST as inert XML; text visibility must not be counted as creative rendering or media playback.
fixtureAssets lists controlled resources; intercept .test URLs locally. Never fetch public advertising/tracking hosts.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

preview.capabilityGap: The current VAST preview is inert XML; video/audio playback and Wrapper resolution are not implemented.
